title: Stuck zip. Part 3
note: Silent. Frame 1 fully composed, no fade, ONE strip (hook, 0-3.0, y=345): his phone lit mid-swipe (generic profile card), her grey suitcase (chartreuse loop) held up with the front zip JAMMED and her phone half stuck in it, ARRIVALS / BELT 4 board. Cold-viewer read: two strangers at baggage claim, her zip is stuck. TAKE 1 (B, plays first, fails on HIM): 3.0-5.3 he flexes (fists up, puffed chest); 5.3-6.3 he yanks the amber zip tab; 6.3 the tab pops off and flies (lands on the belt); he tips backwards, trips over his own bag (tips over, 6.9) and lands on the belt lying down; 7.2-9.5 he rides the belt away a little while she smiles kindly behind her hand (she is amused WITH him, never mocking); her zip still stuck. REWIND 9.6-10.6: belt-flap wipe reversed, hall plays backwards, music ducks. TAKE 2 (A): whole-frame kraft tag, his pen writes (can I try?) 10.8-11.8; slides to her 12.2; 12.5 she reads and nods; 13.0 his pocket phone buzzes (generic lit phone peeking from the jacket pocket), he glances down once and lets it buzz; 14.4 he works the zip tab slowly (wiggle), 15.5 buzzes again, he does not look; 16.5 the zip frees and her phone pops out into her hand (16.8). Music drops out for the shared moment 16.9-20.3: whole-frame tag, his line on top, her pen writes (my hero. / mildly.) 17.7-18.9. PAYOFF OF THE SWIPING THREAD 19.7-21.7: his pocket buzzes a third time, he takes the phone out, the generic lit screen, switches it OFF (screen goes dark) and pockets it; she sees it. CLIFF 21.8-23.4: both look up, the board flips (22.15-22.5) to RIDE / DELAYED 40 MIN. Belt-flap wipe to the vote at 23.4, vote fully up 23.95, end card 29.6. Tags are whole-frame inserts (~920 px wide, Caveat 700, lowercase in parentheses, max 18 chars per line). Text only between y=270 and y=1250. Body strips max 7 words. No NoSwipe mention. No app UI/logos. The joke is only on him.

choices.question: her ride's late. what do I do?
choices.why: Both are about him. A is the honest, sweet answer and pays off the phone he switched off; B callbacks take 1 and embarrasses him (flexing again, carrying both bags). A is the planned winner again; part 4 plays B first and it flops on him, then rewind, then A.

strips.text: the stranger at baggage claim got her phone stuck in her zip.
she caught me swiping. now her zip's stuck.
I yanked it. the zip won.
I tripped on my own bag.
the belt gave me a ride.
my phone buzzed. I let it.
her ride's late. what do I do?
